## What to send us

Drawings (PDF or DWG), the specification or NBS output, the tender bill if there is one, and your return date. IFC or Revit if you have a model. We do not need one.

Attach a file up to 20 MB, or use the document download link field.

## What happens next

We read the pack and come back within one working day with the scope we would measure, a fixed fee and a delivery date. If it is not a package we can do well, we say so and tell you who does.

Priced per package, quoted before we start. No hourly billing and no fee for scope we did not agree.
